notes.title: The Clarity Update
notes.notes:
So far, the biggest issues in LSD seem to stem from a lack of clarity in the UI and the admittedly shitty tutorial. This update attempts to fix this issue with some much needed QOL changes and an interactive, in-game tutorial.

NEW FEATURES
New Shiny Interactive Tutorial
Explains LSD's core mechanics. How to play as the monster, the human and what to do in three player rooms.
Better Death Screens
People were often confused why they died after rounds. The new death screens give a detailed explanation, including who killed them. These death screens also persist through the monster character picking phase.
Replay Voice Filter Toggle
This fun little feature adds a toggle button to the replays, which allows players to toggle the voice filter off and on for the recorded audio. Listening to your friends do their impressions of you without the filter is pretty funny!

UI CHANGES

 Added an additional indicator in the lobby when the player is chosen as a human
 It's now clearer when you are spectating through the addition of a SPECTATING indicitaor in the pre-game. Some players got stuck as spectators without realizing it, this should hopefully fix that.
 Changed the three player room choice buttons colours to blue, so it's clearer that the player you click gets spared.
 Made the replay UI snap-scroll to the replay that get's played and added a blue outline around it


BUG FIXES

 Fixed room UI sometimes not showing up, particularly when playing with "randomize voices"
 Fixed regular plebs sometimes getting deluxe skins applied to when playing with "randomize voices"
 Some behind the scenes stuff that affected a small amount of players


I hope you enjoy these changes!
As always, there are probably some additional bugs introduced by these new features, so expect some hotfix patches within the next couple of days.

~Leonhard

notes.title: The Pretty Update - 7th of December 2022
notes.notes:
I started playing around with Unity's 2D lighting system this week, and once I started I somehow couldn't stop myself until I reworked the entire way I did graphics, lighting and the match UI. I hope you'll like these changes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42692396/b67f79e3392793a2da3ae0d17de23eb3f392c523.gif


 Reworked buttons to have a bit more of a holographic feel and added a new font for them
 Reworked the info boxes to be better visible and look a bit cooler
 Made a better looking timer with the same font as the buttons and a slowly decreasing bar underneath
 Just generally tweaked and moved the UI around
 Forced Unity to use high fidelity images for the character and background graphics, slightly increasing build size, but making them just look so much better on all resolutions
 Reworked lighting system to use Unity's 2D Universal Render Pipe Line lighting, making the colors more vibrant and realistic
 Made the colored lights also change sprites
 Probably some other stuff I forgot about

notes.title: Features, Bug Fixes - 4th December 2022
notes.notes:
It’s been a buggy, but exciting couple of days!
 
Thank you to everyone who has been reporting bugs, I’ve been doing my best to sort them out. This should take care of the most egregious and annoying among them. If you encounter any more, please don’t hesitate to either contact me directly or to use the bug report button in the bottom right corner of the screen. 

CHANGES
Deprecated Mayhem mode to Beta status
I’ve been hearing about a lot of issues with the Mayhem mode, apparently it hasn't been tested enough, so I added a big red BETA signifier on top, so everyone knows what they’re getting into.

Added more questions
To make up for the deprecated feature in the Deluxe edition, and as a small apology to the deluxe LSD’ers who had to deal with the buggy Mayhem mode, I’ve added a bunch of questions to all the question packs. I hope you enjoy them!

 Casual +5
 Icebreaker +4
 Deep +6
 Edgy +13

Screen Settings
I added a full screen toggle as well as a resolution drop-down menu to the settings.

Deprecated replays to Beta status
Replays were the second feature to cause some trouble of these launch days, so I’ve also added a message here to inform people of its current status and to report bugs

BUG-FIXES
Fixed “Not enough players” error, even when there are enough players
This error made me particularly sad, because it’s prevented people from actually playing the game, which is obviously the last thing I want. The problem was basically that the game thought people were spectating when they really weren’t. It should be fixed now.

Fixed “Room not found” error
This usually seemed to happen after rounds were finished. It occurred, when the game thought you were hovering over the kill or spare buttons after a round already finished. Since this isn’t such a problematic thing for the game to think I simply disabled the error message.

Small bugs

 Made the “socket” error message more informative (It occurs when the connection to the server can’t be established)
 Fixed players getting into a room with someone they were disguised as in the Mayhem mode
 Changed the “Not enough players” error message to encourage people to join our Discord server


COMING-SOON

 Another character for the Deluxe pack
 A win counter in the lobby


Thank you for playing, and I hope you continue to have fun with Lightspeed Dating!

notes.title: Demo Release!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42692396/06f42ea04523779156bda80105a8f8442dd3cf03.gif

The demo is out! Be among the first to try out Lightspeed Dating. Available for a limited time only, you can play an abridged, but still extremely fun, version of the newest social deduction game. Grab a couple of friends and find out who they really think you are!

This is essentially a beta version as well as a demo and is as such probably still very buggy. Please share all of the bugs you find with us by pressing the button in the bottom right corner of the screen! And don’t hesitate to let us know what you love and or hate about our game on Twitter or in our Steam Community, we’d love to hear from you 😊. 

We wish you lots of fun!
